scenario_title: Null dereference after a removed guard
title: Elevated 5xx errors on api-gateway
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-06-22 07:54-12:44: api-gateway: 357 of 480 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-06-22 07:54 and 2026-06-22 12:44 UTC (peak error ratio 0.89 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 0.481 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of {svc} removed a null/nil guard; requests for records without the optional field now crash the handler.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) drops the null check before dereferencing the field.
_templates.remediation: Roll back {svc} {version_to} -> {version_from}; restore the guard at {file}:{line}; add a test with the optional field missing.

rca.macro: Deploy v1.16.0 of coord-svc removed a null/nil guard; requests for records without the optional field now crash the handler.
rca.micro: coord/session/SessionTracker.java:172 (SessionTrackerImpl.run) drops the null check before dereferencing the field.
rca.remediation: Roll back coord-svc v1.16.0 -> v1.15.0; restore the guard at coord/session/SessionTracker.java:172; add a test with the optional field missing.

action_items: Add a regression test covering SessionTrackerImpl.run (coord/session/SessionTracker.java).
Alert on the error signature `GET <*> <*> <*> target=cloud-api`.
